name: Integrated Production Bundle (IPB)
description: Vendor product line read 2026-11-24. Proprietary flexible pipe product for flow assurance in viscous oil, deepwater and pressure-constrained conditions. Primary source: https://www.technipfmc.com/en/what-we-do/subsea/subsea-systems/subsea-infrastructure/flexible-pipes/

specifications.value: flexible production riser with thermal insulation layers, additional hoses for gas lift/other services, active heating through electric cables, fluid temperature monitoring with optical fibres

specifications.basis: The IPB allows for high-level flow assurance of hydrocarbon fluids in difficult conditions from well heads to surface treatment units. The IPB is a flexible production riser
features thermal insulation layers, additional hoses for gas lift or other services, active heating through electric cables, and fluid temperature monitoring with optical fibers
specifications.value: thermal insulation layers, additional hoses for gas lift or other services, active heating through electric cables, fluid temperature monitoring with optical fibers

specifications.basis: The main components are leakproof thermoplastic barriers and corrosion-resistant steel wires. The helically wound steel wires give the structure its high-pressure resistance
specifications.value: leakproof thermoplastic barriers and corrosion-resistant steel wires, helically wound

specifications.basis: providing flexibility and superior dynamic performance
specifications.value: high-pressure resistance, excellent bending characteristics, flexibility, superior dynamic performance

specifications.basis: flexible pipe can be easily retrieved to be reused on another field development or for decommissioning
specifications.value: can be easily retrieved to be reused on another field development or for decommissioning
Freestanding Hybrid Riser (FSHR): vertical steel pipe tensioned by near-surface buoyancy can, flexible jumper, rigid base jumper

notes: Proprietary flexible pipe product for flow assurance in viscous oil, deepwater and pressure-constrained conditions. Full-parameter pass 2026-11-26: 6 new printed parameters.
